title: Why it sucks being a KRC Genk fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Genk fan!
It starts when you're six. Everyone calls your club "Gent". It's Genk. With a K. Now you know how Gent fans feel.
Age eight. Your club's nickname is... the Smurfs. Try saying that in a fight.
Age eleven. You win the league! Champions League! First game: Salzburg. A young striker called Haaland scores a hat-trick. Before half-time.
Age twelve. You finally buy your favourite striker's shirt. One week later... he leaves. For Aston Villa.
Age fourteen. Your academy produces superstars. A world-class keeper. A world-class midfielder. They all leave. The club calls it... a business model.
Age fifteen. Last day of the season. You're winning. The title is yours! Ninety-fourth minute... a defender scores a volley. Antwerp win the league. In your stadium.
That's the thing about being a Genk fan. You raise superstars... for other clubs.
But every weekend, you can point at the TV and say: "He played for us." For about six months.
Tag a Genk fan. Not a Gent fan. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
